'''Cooling coils''' were weapon components used on [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] such as the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]]. Located on the weapon's [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], the coils forced a liquid [[Coolant/Legends|cooling agent]] known as [[freelol]] into the blaster rifle's internal capillary system to cool its vital components during use.<ref name="EGWT" />
